title: CIDG seizes P1.7-M ‘smuggled’ cigarettes in Zamboanga Sibugay

blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur — At least P1.7 million worth of alleged smuggled cigarettes were seized from two suspects during a joint law enforcement operation in Barangay Poblacion, Ipil, Zamboanga Sibugay, the Criminal Investigation and Detection Group – Region 9 (CIDG-9) said Sunday. Operatives from the CIDG Zamboanga Sibugay and the Ipil Municipal Police Station conducted the raid at around 3 p.m. on Thursday. CIDG-9 chief Col. Rafael Lero said the operation led to the apprehension of two suspects, identified by the aliases “Ben” and “Adi,” both of legal age. They were caught in possession of 35 master cases of […]...
